frameFormat: [page, x, y, w, h, trimX, trimY, fullW, fullH]

move.note: quick bouncing hops; play at any move speed

windup.note: lasts exactly the telegraph (12 ticks). In Guided mode the wind-up holds: hold the last frame (intensity 1). telegraphIntensity: per-frame alpha (0..1) for the telegraph layer. It ramps up through the wind-up and fades smoothly through the first half of the attack (no hard cut). Multiply it into the tinted layer's alpha

attack.note: the Swarmer's jab: a quick stretchy poke

stagger.note: dizzy wobble; loop for as long as the stagger lasts

defeat.note: dissolves into light and sparkles (a hopeful 'set free', not a death). The last frame is empty
